latest_release.name: v18.2.0
latest_release.body:
# [18.2.0](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.1.3...v18.2.0) (2026-11-09)


### Bug Fixes

* keep hard line breaks in image alt text ([#4187](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4187)) ([ed54c54](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/ed54c541ef75740634a09233c685a5bba1e92944))
* let emphasis open after the other delimiter character ([#4169](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4169)) ([219492a](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/219492a64e5cd0a7f264678b7a80bdd2201c970b))
* let emphasis open and close in angle brackets that are not html ([#4190](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4190)) ([7bfa1f7](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/7bfa1f70e8756c6ee3e47c235a34556edbf48b49))
* preserve zero from named extension renderers ([#4199](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4199)) ([b81a00a](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/b81a00a2e332a47e0ccc0ff376babfe78392f321))
* text after a heading or code block in a nested list item is pulled into the outer item ([#4179](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4179)) ([4cb767a](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/4cb767a966b496eb74cb2779ff2b8d0054a2a035))


### Features

* add lastToken to lexer state ([#4160](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4160)) ([e4ab77f](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e4ab77f6e46d478cfed8697c308dddc60b9ddf99))
